children.content: Oct 16. 2025 Analogue 3D - October 16th Update Analogue 3D remains on target to ship in Q4 of this year. There is no change in price or added cost for all open preorders. read more Aug 20. 2025 Analogue 3D - Shipping in Q4 Nonetheless, we know this sucks. Hardware, system, packaging — the full kit — been set for months. The last 1% is where we’re focused.

children.name: page-developer-subtitle
children.content: Introducing openFPGA. The future of video game preservation.

children.name: page-developer-panel-title
children.content: Introducing openFPGA. The future of video game preservation.

children.name: page-developer-p-0
children.content: Introducing openFPGA. The future of video game preservation.

children.name: page-developer-p-1
children.content: openFPGA starts at the beginning of Video Games: Spacewar! on PDP-1 In 1962, the first digital video game, Spacewar! debuted on an early computer released in 1959 called the PDP-1 at MIT.

children.name: page-developer-p-2
children.content: The beginning of video games. Spacewar! set forth and established the fundamental characteristics and philosophical approaches that would define and serve as the earliest guidelines of what a video game is. Inspired by science fiction literature and cinema. Driven by creatively pushing technology to its limits.

children.name: page-developer-p-3
children.content: SpaceWar! was released on a computer produced in 1959 called the PDP-1. Spacewar! is arguably the first digital video game ever created. PDP-1 has been painstakingly recreated with the public domain open source code for openFPGA by a 3rd party developer. So it can be preserved, studied and played forever without compromises.

children.content: Introducing openFPGA. The future of video game preservation.

children.name: page-3d-p-1
children.content: 1 2 3 4 One hundred percent compatibility. For the first time ever. Analogue 3D represents a milestone in video game preservation. It's not just a reimagining of the N64—it's the first fully compatible, hardware-accurate recreation, fully compatible with the entire N64 game library. After nearly four years of dedicated FPGA engineering, Analogue 3D overcomes the limitations of software emulation—no input lag, no graphic or audio inaccuracies, no timing or frame rate problems. This is the N64, perfected and true to its core

children.name: page-3d-p-2
children.content: New! Analogue Cartridge Cleaners. Made for your games to last. Analogue Cartridge Cleaners remove oxidation using a proprietarily designed dry, precision-fit cleaning pad without fluids or chemicals. Designed specifically for original cartridges to restore and maintain your physical media. Your games will be more reliable and preserved for the long run. Proper care - so you can play for generations.

children.name: page-3d-p-3
children.content: The unmistakable Signature and Soul of the CRT. On your HDTV. In 4K. Unlike its 2D predecessors, the N64 wasn't just about pixels. The original hardware's distinctive approach to rendering polygons and textures depends on the CRT far more critically than simpler 2D systems. Even game developers had to leverage the interplay between the hardware and a CRT to achieve harmony.

children.name: page-pocket-subtitle
children.content: A multi-video-game-system portable handheld. A digital audio workstation with a built-in synthesizer and sequencer. A tribute to portable gaming.

children.name: page-pocket-panel-title
children.content: Meet Analogue Pocket. A tribute to portable gaming.

children.name: page-pocket-p-0
children.content: A multi-video-game-system portable handheld. A digital audio workstation with a built-in synthesizer and sequencer. A tribute to portable gaming.

children.name: page-pocket-p-1
children.content: Original Display Modes Transform Pocket's display into the display on an original GB, GBC, or GBA. Quirks and all. Pocket's 615ppi display allows astonishingly accurate recreation of original hardware display characteristics like backlight LCD effects, pixel grid patterns and LCD subpixel patterns.

children.name: page-pocket-p-2
children.content: Pocket does it all Pocket is the ultimate tribute to portable gaming. We designed four unique portable video game system based cartridge adapters that allow you to play your original game cartridges on. Game Gear, Neo Geo Pocket & Neo Geo Pocket Color, TurboGrafx-16, PC Engine & SuperGrafx & Atari Lynx. Each adapter includes several Original Display Modes specific to each system. So you can explore portable gaming history with no compromises.

children.name: page-pocket-p-3
children.content: AP_01 Game Gear The Game Gear Adapter allows you to play your original Sega Game Gear cartridges on Analogue Pocket. Three Original Display Modes are available with this: Analogue GG, Original GG, Original GG+.

children.name: page-duo-p-1
children.content: Duo does it all. Hucards & CD-ROM2. Duo is the ultimate all-in-one NEC video game system. Duo features an original-style cartridge slot, controller port and CD-ROM drive. This means it is compatible with all game formats: Hucards, TurboChips, and CD-ROM. Plus the original hardware and accessories.

children.name: page-duo-p-2
children.content: We're Preserving Video Game History with FPGA Hardware. Unlike traditional emulators that mimic console behavior through software, FPGA recreates the original hardware at the circuit level. It doesn't just simulate—it behaves exactly like the original system, delivering unparalleled accuracy, flawless timing, and true-to-life performance.

children.name: page-duo-p-3
children.content: Physical Compatibility FPGA: Can directly interface with original cartridges, discs and accessories because it recreates the console at the electrical + timing level. Everything behaves like original hardware.
